summary.text: Eric Pratt is the Republican nominee for the open 2nd District seat. A Prior Lake native with a career in banking and finance, he began in public service on the Prior Lake-Savage school board and has served in the Minnesota Senate since 2013. His campaign website describes his priorities as affordability, safer communities and accountability.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Prior Lake, Minnesota, where he still lives; graduated from Prior Lake High School. His campaign website says his father worked in real estate and his mother taught in Shakopee for more than 25 years.
Earned a B.A. in economics from the University of Colorado, Boulder, where he played Division I football, and an M.B.A. in finance from the University of St. Thomas.

Worked in banking and finance, including as an analyst at ITT Consumer Finance and First Banks System, assistant vice president at FirstPlus Financial, senior group manager at Target, and senior vice president of risk management at U.S. Bank.
Began his public service on the Prior Lake-Savage school board.
Elected to the Minnesota Senate in 2012 (District 55, taking office in 2013); has represented District 54 since January 2023.

In the state Senate, chaired the Jobs and Economic Growth Finance and Policy Committee in 2019-2020 and 2021-2022; for 2025-2026 he is ranking minority member of the Finance Committee and sits on the Capital Investment Committee.
Won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary for Minnesota's 2nd District.
According to his campaign website, he and his wife Tina have been married 34 years and raised two children, Cam and Sammi, in the district.
